summary: Rani Therapeutics filed an 8-K reporting a securities purchase agreement with institutional investors for a registered direct offering of 12,476,637 Class A common shares and pre-funded warrants for 6,214,953 shares at $1.07 per share and $1.0699 per warrant, raising ~$20M gross. The offering is scheduled to close May 27, 2026. H.C. Wainwright and Chardan Capital Markets serve as placement agents. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation. No special-situation dynamics apply.
